description: The HR-72 RTO serves the Gurugram (South) jurisdiction in Haryana and is primarily responsible for the registration of private non-transport vehicles. It operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) to handle the heavy volume of vehicle registrations in the southern part of the city, which is a major corporate and residential hub.
address: SDM (South) Gurgaon, Vikas Sadan, Opposite Mini Secretariat, Gurugram, Haryana
